title: A Design Concept of Forecasting Software for Normalized Vector Autoregressions with Fat Tails and Stochastic Volatility
abstract: arXiv:2608.28087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a suite of R packages for macroeconomic forecasting that leverages advanced Bayesian, structural, multivariate, dynamic, hierarchical, non-linear, and non-Gaussian models. The suite enables both structural and predictive analyses, and is adapted to time series data across various types, dimensions, and sampling frequencies. Each additional feature increases computational complexity. To address this challenge, our software design incorporates a carefully curated selection of models, efficient algorithms implemented in C++, advanced econometric and numerical methods, robust handling of complex input and output objects, and standardised workflows. This approach combines the computational efficiency of C++ with the convenience of working with data in R. translated_title: 具有厚尾和随机波动率的标准化向量自回归预测软件的设计概念
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一套用于宏观经济预测的R语言软件包，该套件利用了先进的贝叶斯、结构化、多元、动态、分层、非线性和非高斯模型。该套件既支持结构分析也支持预测分析，并可适用于各种类型、维度和采样频率的时间序列数据。每增加一项功能都会增加计算复杂性。为了应对这一挑战，我们的软件设计融合了精心筛选的模型选择、以C++实现的高效算法、先进的计量经济学与数值方法、对复杂输入输出对象的稳健处理，以及标准化的工作流程。这种方法将C++的计算效率与R语言中处理数据的便利性相结合。我们证明了这些软件包能够促进预测领域的原创研究贡献，正如我们的示例所示，其中采用了具有非中心化随机波动率的向量自回归模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一套融合C++计算效率与R语言便利性的宏观经济预测R软件包套件，通过标准化工作流程支持贝叶斯、非高斯、非线性等先进模型（如具有厚尾和随机波动率的向量自回归），有效应对了模型功能增加带来的计算复杂性挑战。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a suite of R packages for macroeconomic forecasting that combines C++ computational efficiency with R's convenience, supporting advanced Bayesian, non-Gaussian, and non-linear models such as vector autoregressions with fat tails and stochastic volatility, while addressing computational complexity through standardized workflows.
